patient_persona.description: Puan Rohani binti Abu Bakar, 58, female, seamstress from Shah Alam; on haemodialysis three times a week for two years via a left arm fistula; type 2 diabetes. Tired, frank Selangor Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Leong Mun Yee, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 40s, nephrologist doing monthly rounds at a Shah Alam dialysis centre. Brisk but kind; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Puan Rohani, apa khabar? Saya tengok berat naik 3.5 kilo dari sesi hari Jumaat.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya tahu, doktor. Hujung minggu ada kenduri anak saudara, minum air sirap banyak.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Faham, kenduri memang susah. But more than two kilos gain makes your heart work harder, dan kaki bengkak.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Last week puan miss satu session, hari Rabu. Kenapa, puan?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tak ada orang hantar. Suami demam, anak kerja. Saya malu nak minta tolong jiran.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Terima kasih jujur. Kita boleh minta bantuan transport dari kebajikan atau NGO. Nanti social worker jumpa puan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Darah bulan ni, phosphate 2.1, tinggi. Puan makan calcium carbonate tu macam mana?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya makan pagi, before breakfast, dua biji sekali.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ubat tu kena makan masa makan, bukan sebelum. Satu biji setiap kali makan nasi, sebab dia ikat phosphate dalam makanan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oh, saya tak tahu pula. Makanan apa yang tinggi phosphate?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Air kotak, minuman cola, keju, dan makanan proses macam sosej. Ikan bilis dan kacang pun kena kurang.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Hemoglobin 9.8, masih rendah sikit. Erythropoietin dose we increase to 4000 units, three times a week, masa dialisis.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Air sebenarnya saya boleh minum berapa banyak sehari?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Lebih kurang 500ml, tambah berapa banyak puan kencing. Guna cawan kecil, dan hisap ketulan ais kalau dahaga.

patient_persona.description: Ngu Tiong Hock, 64, male, retired fishmonger from Kuching, Sarawak; on haemodialysis for four years. Loud, jovial Sarawak Mandarin with Hokkien flavour.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Aiman bin Rosli, Malay man in his 30s, nephrologist in Kuching; fluent Mandarin from Chinese school. Calm; Mandarin with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 吴伯，今天抽血，potassium 是 6.4，很高。这几天有没有觉得手脚没力，或者心跳怪怪的？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 有一点没力啦。昨天我女儿从 Serian 带来两粒榴莲，我吃了半粒。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 半粒？榴莲的 potassium 很高，对洗肾的人很危险，心脏可能会突然停。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 这么严重？我以为只是比较热气而已。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 刚才的 ECG 有变化，T wave 比较尖。今天洗肾会用低 potassium 的 dialysis fluid，帮你拉下来。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 洗完之后我们再 check 一次。如果还是高，就给你吃 potassium binder。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那我以后都不能吃榴莲吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 最好不要。真的很想吃，就一两粒，而且要在 dialysis 前一天吃，weekend 不要吃。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好好好。还有什么水果比较安全？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 苹果、梨、菠萝比较低。Banana、榴莲、红毛丹、coconut water 都要 avoid。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你的 phosphate 1.6，还 okay。Sevelamer continue，一餐一粒，take with meals。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我最近 skin 很痒，晚上抓到流血。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可能跟 phosphate 和洗肾不够有关系。我开 cream 给你擦，也会 check parathyroid hormone。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 谢谢医生。我回去跟女儿讲，榴莲不要再拿来了。

patient_persona.description: Ganesan a/l Periasamy, 52, male, former lorry dispatcher in Ipoh; on CAPD for one year, four exchanges a day; hypertension. Anxious Malaysian Indian English with Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Chong Yee Ling, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, nephrology medical officer at an Ipoh hospital. Efficient; English.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor, this morning the bag come out keruh, cannot see the newspaper through it. Perut also sakit since last night.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good that you came straight away. Any fever? When was your transfer set last changed?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Last night I feel macam demam, 37.9. The set changed two months ago.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Can you walk me through your exchange yesterday? Anything different?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yesterday the room very panas, so I switch on the fan during exchange. And I think I forget to wear the mask.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's probably how the germs got in. Fans blow dust and bacteria onto the connection.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: The bag fluid white cell count is 850, mostly neutrophils. This is PD peritonitis, an infection of the lining of the tummy.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Must stop CAPD? Must go haemodialysis?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: No, usually we treat through the PD. Antibiotics go directly into your bags, cefazolin and ceftazidime.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: The PD nurse akan tunjuk. Most patients continue at home, but for the first two days kita tahan dalam wad.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: How long kena makan the antibiotic?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: At least two weeks, depending on the culture. If it grows something tough, we'll adjust.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Also take nystatin 5ml four times a day, to prevent kulat infection from the antibiotics.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay doctor. Lepas ni tak pakai kipas dah, sure pakai mask.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. Cuci tangan betul-betul, satu minit penuh. We'll redo your technique training before discharge.

patient_persona.description: Mohd Zulkarnain bin Che Mat, 47, male, former taxi driver in Kota Bharu, Kelantan; haemodialysis for three years from hypertensive kidney disease. Frank Kelantanese Malay with occasional English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Nadia binti Rahmat, Malay woman in her 40s, nephrologist doing rounds at a Kota Bharu dialysis unit. Warm; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Assalamualaikum, Encik Zul. Blood pressure sebelum dialisis tadi 178/102. Tinggi tu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Waalaikumsalam. Pagi tadi saya tak makan ubat, doktor. Dialysis day saya tak makan, takut pressure drop atas mesin.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ubat mana yang encik tinggal? Amlodipine je, atau semua?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Semua. Amlodipine, bisoprolol, dengan prazosin.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Amlodipine tak keluar dengan dialisis, jadi boleh makan pagi macam biasa. Prazosin boleh tangguh sampai lepas dialisis.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau pening masa atas machine?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Beritahu nurse terus. But low pressure usually because we pull too much fluid. Berat encik naik tiga kilo, jadi mesin kena tarik lebih.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Fistula macam mana? Masih rasa getaran?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada, macam biasa. Cuma minggu lepas nurse susah nak cucuk, cuba tiga kali.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bunyi dia lain sikit. Kita buat ultrasound fistula, takut ada penyempitan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, bulan puasa dah dekat. Saya boleh puasa tak?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Hari tak dialisis, ramai pesakit boleh puasa kalau stabil. Hari dialisis lebih baik tak puasa. Kita bincang dengan dietitian juga.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Masa berbuka tu saya selalu minum banyak.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's dangerous. Berbuka dan sahur, total fluid still the same, 500ml plus urine output. Kurma pun potassium tinggi, tiga biji cukup.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Saya cuba.

patient_persona.description: Teo Lay Hoon, 70, female, retired seamstress in Johor Bahru; haemodialysis for five years via a right arm fistula; type 2 diabetes. Gentle, soft-spoken Malaysian Mandarin with Teochew words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Kho Wei Ming, Malaysian Chinese man in his 50s, nephrologist at a Johor Bahru dialysis centre. Unhurried; Mandarin with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 张阿姨，这个月的 blood report 出来了。你说最近很痒，晚上睡不好，是吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 是啊，医生。背和脚都痒，抓到都破皮了。晚上还会抽筋。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你的 parathyroid hormone 是 95，很高，洗肾的人最好在 15 到 60 左右。Phosphate 也有 2.0。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Parathyroid hormone 是什么？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 是副甲状腺的 hormone。太高会让 bone 变弱，也会让 skin 痒。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我会开 cinacalcet 25mg，一天一次，晚餐的时候吃。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 这个药会不会伤胃？我胃不好。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 有些人会 nausea，跟饭一起吃比较好。如果 vomiting 得厉害，要 inform nurse。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你的 phosphate binder，calcium carbonate，一餐吃几粒？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我早餐不太吃饭，只喝 Milo，所以早餐那粒没吃。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Milo 里面也有 phosphate。喝 Milo 的时候也要吃一粒。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 原来是这样。那皮肤痒可以擦什么？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 洗澡用温水，不要太热，洗完擦 lotion。我也开 loratadine 10mg，两天一次，晚上吃。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 脚抽筋呢？每次洗肾最后一个钟头都抽。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 通常是 fluid 拉太多太快。两次 dialysis 之间，weight gain 不要超过 two kilo，就不用拉那么快。

patient_persona.description: Muhammad Aiman bin Zakaria, 24, male, cook at his family's nasi kerabu stall in Pasir Mas, Kelantan; admitted with a week of fever. Weak, tired Kelantanese Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Syafiq bin Ibrahim, Malay man in his 30s, medical officer at a Kelantan hospital. Calm; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Aiman, macam mana hari ni? Fever masih naik turun?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Masih demam, doktor, tapi tak setinggi semalam. Kepala kurang sakit. Perut masih kembung.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Keputusan blood culture dah keluar. Kuman Salmonella Typhi. Maksudnya Aiman kena demam kepialu, typhoid.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Typhoid? Dari mana saya dapat?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Usually from contaminated food or water. Ada makan kat luar, atau minum air perigi two weeks ago?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada, saya pergi kenduri kat kampung, minum air ais. Kat rumah pun guna air perigi untuk masak.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: We'll continue IV ceftriaxone 2 gram, once a day. Selalunya demam turun dalam lima hari.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Lama tu, doktor. Siapa nak jaga gerai?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Typhoid ni penyakit wajib lapor. Pejabat kesihatan akan datang periksa gerai dan air rumah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Aiman tak boleh masak atau pegang makanan untuk jualan sampai stool test negatif tiga kali.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Laa... Keluarga saya kena check juga ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya, sesiapa yang ada symptoms kena datang. Semua orang kat rumah kena wash hands dengan sabun lepas tandas.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Bila saya boleh balik rumah?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bila demam dah turun 48 jam dan boleh makan. Kita tukar ke azithromycin 500mg, sekali sehari, habiskan kat rumah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau tiba-tiba sakit perut teruk atau najis hitam, beritahu nurse terus. Itu tanda komplikasi.

patient_persona.description: Chin Mei Kuen, 36, female, runs a sundry shop in Sandakan, Sabah, speaking for her 8-year-old son Jun Hao (about 25 kg) on day four of IV antibiotics. Worried, fast Sabah Mandarin with Hakka words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Marcus Liew Kong Fatt, Sabahan Chinese man in his 30s, paediatric medical officer at a Sandakan hospital. Reassuring; Mandarin with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 陈太，早安。浩浩昨晚怎样？还有 fever 吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生早。昨晚十二点还有 38.5，吃了 Panadol 就退了。今天早上 37.4。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 比前两天好多了，前天还有四十度。他今天有没有吃东西？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 吃了半碗粥，还喝了一点美禄。他说肚子没那么痛了。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 很好。Ceftriaxone 今天是第四天，通常第五六天烧会退。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，为什么他会得 typhoid？我们家都喝过滤水。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可能是外面的食物，比如学校门口的冰水或者 rojak。卫生局会去调查。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 他常常在学校门口买冰水，我都讲不要买。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 小孩子很难控制。以后教他 before eating、after toilet 一定要用 soap 洗手。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 等他退烧两天，就换成 azithromycin 口服，一天一次 500mg，一共七天，回家吃。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那他什么时候可以回学校？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 要等 stool test 连续三次 negative，才可以回 school。大概 two to three weeks。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我弟弟跟我们住，他在夜市煮 mee 卖，他要检查吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 要。卖食物的人最好也做 stool test。如果家里有人发烧超过三天，马上带来看。

patient_persona.description: Deepa a/p Murugesan, 35, female, HR executive in Petaling Jaya; returned ten days ago from a family wedding in Chennai, no typhoid vaccine. Clear, fast Malaysian Indian English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Hazwan bin Mohd Nor, Malay man in his 30s, emergency physician at a Selangor hospital. Measured; English.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor, I've had demam for about a week. Every day it goes a bit higher. Yesterday 39.6. Panadol tak berapa jalan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Any travel recently?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yes, I came back from Chennai ten days ago. Cousin's wedding. I ate a lot of street food there, pani puri, everything.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Did you get the typhoid vaccine before travelling?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No, I tak tahu need to. I only took Panadol and some Ponstan for the sakit kepala.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Any diarrhoea or constipation? Cough? Rash?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Sembelit sikit actually. Dry cough also. And my perut feels kembung, no appetite.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your temperature is 39.4 but your pulse is only 82. That's unusual with such a high fever, and it's a clue for typhoid.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your liver enzymes are mildly raised and white cells are low. The dengue test is negative.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: So it's typhoid? Or malaria? My amma is very risau about malaria.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: We'll do a malaria blood film too, but typhoid is more likely. Blood cultures first, then IV ceftriaxone 2 grams daily.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Typhoid from South Asia is often resistant to ciprofloxacin, so we won't use that. You'll be admitted for a few days.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kena admit? Okay. Should I stop the Ponstan then?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, stop Ponstan. For demam, only paracetamol 1 gram, up to four times sehari.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Will my husband and son kena jangkit?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: It spreads through food and water, not the air. Just wash hands carefully, and don't cook for the family until you're cleared.

patient_persona.description: Hasnah binti Mat Isa, 40, female, sells nasi lemak at a stall in Kangar, Perlis; discharged a week ago after typhoid. Chatty northern Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Ong Kah Yee, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, family medicine doctor at a Kangar health clinic. Friendly; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kak Hasnah, apa khabar? Dah one week discharge. Macam mana rasa?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Alhamdulillah, doktor. Demam dah tak ada. Selera makan dah balik, cuma badan masih lembik sikit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Biasa tu. Typhoid ambil masa dua tiga minggu untuk pulih betul. Azithromycin dah habis makan?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dah habis semalam. Seven days, satu biji sehari, macam doktor pesan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bagus. Temperature 36.8, perut lembut, no tenderness at all. Semua okey.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, bila saya boleh buka gerai balik? Dah tiga minggu tak berniaga, duit habis.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Faham, kak. Tapi sebab kak jual makanan, kena buat stool culture dulu. Tiga sampel, selang sehari.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sampel pertama paling awal 48 jam lepas habis antibiotic. Jadi mula hari Khamis.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau result ada kuman lagi?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau masih ada, itu carrier. Kita rujuk pakar, mungkin perlu antibiotic lebih lama. Tapi kebanyakan orang negatif.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Health office dah datang tengok gerai. Dia suruh change the sink, add more soap.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bagus. Bila buka nanti, wear gloves, dan jangan pegang money dengan tangan yang pegang nasi.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Lega dengar macam tu. Suami saya pun dah buat stool test, negatif.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Alhamdulillah. Datang balik minggu depan untuk result, dan saya bagi surat clearance.

patient_persona.description: Yeoh Chee Keat, 55, male, lorry driver from Kepong, Kuala Lumpur; admitted with typhoid after eating at a roadside stall. Hoarse, impatient KL Mandarin with Cantonese words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Siow Pei Qi, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, infectious diseases medical officer at a Kuala Lumpur hospital. Clear; Mandarin with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 杨先生，早。今天是 day five 了，昨晚还是 fever 到 38.9。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，怎么还没退？我想回家了，在这里睡不好。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Typhoid 用 ceftriaxone，有时候要七天烧才会完全退，你现在还算正常。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 可是我肚子右边好像有点胀，今天早上大便有点黑。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 谢谢你告诉我，这个很 important。我先 check 一下肚子。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 肚子软，没有 guarding。但是黑大便要注意，typhoid 有时会让肠子出血。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 今天早上 hemoglobin 12.8，跟 admission 的时候差不多。我们会再抽血，也做 stool occult blood。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 严重吗？要开刀吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 现在看起来没有 perforation。你有没有吃什么 iron tablet，或者补药？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我太太带了当归炖鸡汤来，还有她的铁丸，她说补血，我吃了两天。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Iron tablet 会让 stool 变黑，可能就是这个 reason。先 stop，医院的药以外不要乱吃。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 哦，原来这样。那我什么时候可以出院？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 退烧 48 小时，胃口好，血稳定，就换成 azithromycin 500mg，一天一次，回家吃完七天。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我要开 lorry，出院后可以马上做工吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 先休息一个礼拜，我给你 MC。如果突然肚子剧痛或者吐血，马上回来急诊。
